id: \rDo you ever just want to disappear?
en: \rDo you ever just want to disappear?
it: \rTi capita mai di voler semplicemente sparire?

id: \rDon't ever say I've done nothing for you.
en: \rDon't ever say I've done nothing for you.
it: \rNon dire mai che non ho fatto niente per te.

id: \bDon't rush me. I'll get in when I'm good and ready.
en: \bDon't rush me. I'll get in when I'm good and ready.
it: \bNon mettermi fretta. Entrerò quando sarò pronto.

id: \bWelcome. Where would you like to go?
en: \bWelcome. Where would you like to go?

id: \rLillie: Hi \PN. How is your project coming? Have you caught any new Pokémon? Please show me.
en: \rLillie: Hi \PN. How is your project coming? Have you caught any new Pokémon? Please show me.
it: \rLylia: Ciao \PN. Come va il tuo progetto? Hai catturato nuovi Pokémon? Fammi vedere, ti prego.

id: \rLillie: You're looking for the Island Kuhuna. Maybe you should check in with my brother. I think he is on the Ancient Poni Path.
en: \rLillie: You're looking for the Island Kuhuna. Maybe you should check in with my brother. I think he is on the Ancient Poni Path.
it: \rLylia: Stai cercando il Kahuna dell'isola. Forse dovresti chiedere a mio fratello. Credo che sia sull'Antico Sentiero di Poni.

id: \rI'm always willing to teach this move to travelers.
en: \rI'm always willing to teach this move to travelers.
it: \rSono sempre disposta a insegnare questa mossa ai viaggiatori.
\rIl nostro Kahuna si è ritirato da poco.

id: \bI'm sure Tapu Fini will pick someone soon.
en: \bI'm sure Tapu Fini will pick someone soon.
it: \bSono sicuro che Tapu Fini sceglierà presto qualcuno.

id: \rWhat's your hurry? Sit down and relax.
en: \rWhat's your hurry? Sit down and relax.
